$comment: Public signing configuration. NO secrets here. 'publisher' must equal the signing certificate's Subject exactly; package.ps1 refuses to sign if they differ. Switch profile to 'release' once a trusted code-signing certificate is available and set its exact Subject.

dev.description: Self-signed development certificate created by new-dev-cert.ps1. Only trusted on machines where trust-dev-cert.ps1 was run.

release.description: Trusted code-signing certificate (CA-issued or Azure Trusted Signing). Replace with the certificate's exact Subject.
